item.subject: maths
item.stem:
Ishaan studies the diagram of square $PQRS$. Dashed segment $PR$ is a diagonal. Grey points $M$, $N$, $O$, $T$ are the midpoints of the sides, joined to form square $MNOT$.

Which plan correctly doubles the area of $PQRS$ and which plan halves it?

options.A: Join the midpoints to double the area, and build on diagonal $PR$ to halve it.
options.B: Build a new square on diagonal $PR$ to double the area; join midpoints $M$, $N$, $O$, $T$ to halve it.
options.C: Use either construction for either goal, because the starting figure need not be a square.
options.D: Treat every inscribed quadrilateral inside $PQRS$ as a half-area square.
